<!-- Source page: Pleroma -->

[Pleroma](https://pleroma.social/) is a lightweight activity pub server. Pleroma was forked into <a href="Akkoma" class="wikilink" title="Akkoma">Akkoma</a>.

It is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-pleroma).
